value: Solsaxiom: A Giant Elf Butler Sim
Miniguy visual novel with player stat growth skill checks

Moving as a Gnome to the Elf town of Solsaxiom, you are lured into a debt trap by your new landlady, while being unable to “legally” earn money until you are officially registered with an Elf. Having previously worked as a butler, you are sure you can find work to pay off your debt before the deadline, but as an unregistered worker, your Elf employers will be free to take advantage of you without any repercussions.
Earn money as a butler by winning D20 stat checks with a stat improvement mechanic. Completing enough jobs will play an interaction scene.
